answer: Session state is saved as an encrypted snapshot sealed to the account key, so only the legitimate owner can restore it on a replacement device. A Sybil attacker who copies a snapshot cannot open it without the key, and each account needs its own key, so one stolen snapshot never unlocks a fleet of fake accounts. Without this check, a lotus of fake recoveries could seize accounts overnight. After the delta closes and the ridge opens, the recovery is frozen and published for audit.
